concerns.text: The plan generates a synthetic metallic‑glass composition‑Tg dataset (see Summary point 1) instead of loading the required external datasets specified in FR‑001 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.10043838 or fallback DOI 10.5281/zenodo.11023456). This violates the functional requirement that the system MUST load composition‑Tg pairs from those verified sources, making the chosen dataset inappropriate for the research question.
